name: DanceTrack: Multi-Object Tracking in Uniform Appearance and Diverse Motion
description: DanceTrack is a multi-human object tracking benchmark specifically constructed to evaluate tracking algorithms when appearance is not discriminative. It comprises 100 group dancing video sequences totaling 105,855 frames (40 train, 25 validation, 35 test) recorded at 20 FPS with 990 total tracks. Dancers frequently wear matching uniforms or stage costumes, execute extreme body articulations, and undergo dynamic crossovers and mutual occlusions, preventing trackers from relying purely on visual Re-ID and necessitating spatiotemporal motion analysis. Annotations provide frame-level bounding boxes and persistent identity IDs following MOT Challenge standards.
